candidates.dedupeCheck: No seed incident or candidate shares this identity. Related in pattern only to incident:railway-env-vars-2026 (same month, same AI-key targeting); no shared attacker is established.

claims.statement: On October 30, 2026 an attacker exploited a previously unknown flaw in a Northflank API component to run commands inside it; that component could reach the platform database and the keys used to decrypt stored secrets.

The attacker decrypted and exfiltrated environment variables and secret files in project secret groups, team-wide secrets, notification integration credentials and static bring-your-own-cloud credentials. Northflank reports no evidence that user credentials, customer personal data or workloads were accessed.
About 1.5% of customer teams had secret values extracted, and about 1.8% of stored secret values were exfiltrated.
Customer reports of misuse so far involve AI provider keys; Northflank says the attacker's filters targeted keys from providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic and Google.

Northflank's monitoring alerted at 11:43 UTC on October 30 and the flaw was fixed at 13:05 UTC. It told all users to treat every secret as exposed, revoked all Northflank API tokens, rotated platform and integration keys, re-encrypted secrets under new keys and engaged FTI Consulting for forensics.
BleepingComputer reported the alert came from Wiz and that Wiz counted at least nine incidents at AI developer platforms in October 2026.

unresolvedQuestions: Northflank's own report credits its monitoring for the 11:43 UTC alert and Wiz only for later investigation help; BleepingComputer says the alert came from Wiz. Keep both attributed.
Unknown: whether the same actor is behind Railway, Northflank and the other October AI-platform incidents. Northflank says only that IPs are similar to those in Wiz's report.

claims.statement: On November 9 and 10, 2026 an unauthorized party used a compromised credential to obtain several account credentials and access related Apify accounts. Apify detected the activity at 12:13 UTC on November 11 and cut off access.
Apify notified customers whose personal information or stored data was accessed; users without an email had not been identified as affected.
Apify rotated critical internal secrets and service credentials, revoked some OAuth connections including GitHub as a precaution, notified authorities, and moved to storing API tokens only as hashes.
On November 16 Apify said it believed it had found the likely root cause and closed the vulnerability that enabled initial access; a preliminary report was planned by November 20.
A customer notice seen by BleepingComputer said affected customers' Apify API tokens and Proxy passwords were rotated and asked recipients to reset 2FA.

unresolvedQuestions: Unknown: what the initial compromised credential was and how it was obtained. Check for Apify's preliminary report (promised by November 20) before review.
Customer-notice details (token rotation, 2FA reset) come from samples BleepingComputer saw, not Apify's public page; attribute them.

claims.statement: Trigger.dev disclosed on November 1, 2026 that an attacker gained unauthorized access to environment variables for a subset of organizations, and said it had blocked the exploit used.
Trigger.dev emailed affected account owners with mitigation steps; it has not said how many organizations were affected, how the attacker got in, or which variables were read.
When The Register asked for more detail, Trigger.dev pointed to a forthcoming full incident report.

claims.statement: Fireworks AI told Notion on November 2, 2026 that attackers had accessed a dataset; on November 6 it said customer data may be involved, and confirmed the final affected dataset on November 8.
The exposed dataset held Notion AI chat transcripts used for the Insights feature, affecting fewer than 1% of workspaces; Notion says most transcripts cannot be tied to a workspace or user.
Notion revoked exposed Notion API keys found in affected messages on November 11 and reported third-party API keys found in them to their issuers on November 12.
Notion told affected customers to rotate any passwords or API keys pasted into Notion AI during the incident period, disconnected from Fireworks and disabled Insights.

unresolvedQuestions: The Notion page dates the third-party key notification November 12 in its timeline but November 13 in its updates list; record both until confirmed.
Unknown: whether any revoked or reported key was misused; Notion's advisory does not say.
